title: Locally constant density at the endpoint of an arc in spt C forces spt C to coincide with the arc's plane near the endpoint
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a 2-dimensional linear subspace, z, e ∈ Q with |z| = |e| = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0, k ∈ ℕ, φ₀ > 0 and δ > 0; write γ(φ) := cos φ·z + sin φ·e and a := γ(φ₀). Assume γ(φ) ∈ spt C for every φ with 0 < φ < φ₀, a ∈ spt C, and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_δ(a). Then there is ε > 0 with spt C ∩ B_ε(a) = Q ∩ B_ε(a) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(a).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z e : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (φ₀ δ : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → z ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → 0 < φ₀ → (∀ φ : ℝ, 0 < φ → φ < φ₀ → Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e ∈ C.support) → Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e ∈ C.support → 0 < δ → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) δ → HasMassDensity C y k) → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) ε ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) ε → HasMassDensity C y k
